title: Monotonicity under coordinate fixing
statement: Let $f$ be a monotone Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, let $J$ be a set of coordinates, and fix a sign $b\in\{-1,1\}$. The function obtained by setting every coordinate in $J$ to $b$ and leaving all other coordinates unchanged before evaluating $f$ is monotone.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a monotone Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
